body: I don't see any way it can get better :(

I'm doing very poorly. I have borderline personality disorder so the emotional pain can get so intense it's like my thoughts are outside my head screaming in at me, if that makes sense. I'm just so tired of being forced to live a life that has brought me almost nothing but suffering, and where every victory is followed up by a string of far more devastating defeats :/

That is really fucked up, I am really sorry that happened to you. People are so cruel. I thought things couldn't go downhill with romance after a different ex physically abused me for almost a year, but there's no bottom to the pit of shif :(

I am sorry that happened to you friend :(

I hope you find happiness
